## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: cyclicals show pockets of strength (Energy, Communication, Real Estate positive) while Financials and several mega-cap Tech names remain BELOW TREND, producing mixed signals; leadership concentrated across 3 sectors in the Top 5, so style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND. Communication/Media also strong with NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND and Real Estate showing follow-through: EQIX cited in sentiment.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag overall: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and sector 1W negative. Consumer Staples/Discretionary mixed-to-weak with EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND and NKE (1W: -6.89% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5 performers (SP100-focused): NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +9.66% | 1M: -21.29%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +9.24% | 1M: -3.51%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) — caution on narrow pockets driving the tape.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -6.00%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +9.08%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -2.79%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high-multiple Tech and Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +9.66% | 1M: -21.29%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present: multiple large-cap names (MSFT, AMZN, META, V, MA) show RECOVERY patterns while NVDA, AAPL, GOOGL remain BELOW TREND — classify as MAJOR divergence, so temper broad regime calls and watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed and transitional: NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND, while INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY and ACN (1W: +9.66% | 1M: -21.29%) RECOVERY show short-term rallies; sector 1W: +0.96% | 1M: -6.44% (24 stocks) — internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing relative weakness: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and sector 1W negative, while payments are RECOVERY (V (1W: +2.39% | 1M: -3.81%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY) — mixed internals, monitor credit/cycle headlines.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare quiet but stable: JNJ (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND, while LLY (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -0.15%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: +0.01% | 1M: +2.30% (17 stocks), defensive underpinning but mixed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
In a NEUTRAL regime favor selective exposure to Energy and strong Communication names while reducing exposure to mega-cap Tech names that remain BELOW TREND. Given the MAJOR divergence across large caps, keep sizing disciplined and monitor sentiment-driven names (PLTR, NFLX) for follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND — watch earnings/operational headlines. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +15.43%) — watch commodity and refining signals. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -5.49%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -2.34%) — watch earnings and macro data.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND — watch a weekly close below recent 1W low as a trend confirmation. AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND — watch for sustained reclaim of 1M bias to signal recovery. NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through above this week’s high to confirm continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ABT (+80): FDA-related approval tone; ABT (1W: data not listed here) but sentiment confirmed historically — cross-check price action before scaling. AVGO (+60): AI chip sales headline aligns with sector interest; watch Broadcom’s price action for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (-55): Analyst cut vs sharp price rally — PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND shows divergence (negative news, rising price) — distribution risk. NVDA (-45): production/headline risk with NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price are confirming downside pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership. NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large caps (MSFT, AMZN, META in RECOVERY vs NVDA, AAPL, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and sentiment/price disconnects in names like PLTR — watch for trend confirmation.
